data: Which of the following models shows the highest accuracy in the validation set for qth percentile values greater than 90?

The question asks which model shows the highest accuracy in the validation set for qth percentile values greater than 90. From the caption, we know that the x-axis represents the selected qth percentiles of the loge frequencies in the training corpus, and the y-axis represents the accuracy when δ is set to the loge frequency value representing the specific qth percentile.

Looking at the graphs:

1. For IMDb (a), BERT_base has the highest accuracy across all qth percentiles, including those greater than 90.
2. For SST-2 (b), BERT_base also has the highest accuracy across all qth percentiles, including those greater than 90.

Since the question does not specify which dataset to consider, we should look at both graphs. In both cases, BERT_base consistently shows the highest accuracy for qth percentiles greater than 90.

Therefore, the model showing the highest accuracy in the validation set for qth percentile values greater than 90 is BERT_base.
